questions.stem: What two substances must both be present for iron to rust?
questions.explanation: Both water (or moisture) and oxygen must be present for iron to rust. If either one is absent, rusting will not occur. This can be demonstrated by placing iron nails in different conditions: nails in boiled water with oil (no oxygen) and nails in dry air with a desiccant (no water) do not rust, while nails exposed to both air and water do rust.
